title: Defined Terms: The Lapsed Document and the Lapse Clock of a Wayfare Document Hold
content:
These defined terms belong to the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product. They set the day from which the lapse clock of a document hold runs, and thereby the lapse allowance days, the calendar days a hold for an expired document may run from its hold start date before it ends in deactivation for document lapse.

### "Lapsed document"

The lapsed document is the required document with the earliest expiry date among:

- the driver's license, the auto insurance and the vehicle inspection, by their expiry dates on the agreement;
- the for-hire permit, by its expiry date on the agreement, on the Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV levels only;
- the vehicle registration on file, which is the latest vehicle registration upload on the standing record, by the expiry date shown on that upload.

### "Covering expiry notice"

An expiry notice on the standing record covers the lapsed document's expiry date when it is sent for that expiry date. The first notice and the second notice are told apart by the notice sequence each one shows.

### "Lapse-clock rule"

The lapse clock runs from:

1. **the date of the second expiry notice** covering the lapsed document's expiry date, when both expiry notices for that date are on the standing record, because the driver was then warned twice;
2. **the lapsed document's expiry date**, when only one of them is on record, which includes two covering notices of which neither is a second notice;
3. **the hold start date**, when no such notice is on record.

The days from the hold start date to the day the clock runs from are added to the lapse allowance days. A clock day before the hold start date makes those days negative, and the lapse allowance days are then shorter by that many days. When the clock runs from the hold start date, nothing is added.

### Worked cases (hypothetical dates)

Lapsed document: the auto insurance, expiry date 2026-05-10. Hold start date 2026-05-11.

| Covering notices on the standing record | Clock runs from | Days from the hold start date to it |
|---|---|---|
| first notice 2026-04-10 and second notice 2026-05-03 | 2026-05-03 | -8 |
| first notice 2026-04-10 only | 2026-05-10 | -1 |
| two notices for 2026-05-10, neither a second notice | 2026-05-10 | -1 |
| none | 2026-05-11 | 0 |

If, in the same hypothetical, the vehicle registration upload on the standing record showed an expiry date of 2026-04-30, the registration would be the lapsed document, and the notices read would be those covering 2026-04-30.
